chapter_seo_title: Evil-Dispelling Divine Lightning vs. Eightfold Golden Light Mirrors: Wen Tianren’s Trump Card
chapter_meta_description: Wen Tianren unleashes his ultimate treasure, the Eightfold Golden Light Mirrors, as Han Li’s Evil-Dispelling Divine Lightning shatters his demonic avatar. Zi Ling watches from the sidelines.
og_title: The Golden Horn Appears: Wen Tianren’s Final Gambit
og_description: Han Li’s Gold Lightning Bamboo just hard-countered a True Demon Avatar. Now Wen Tianren drops the Eightfold Golden Light Mirrors—and the real fight begins.
twitter_description: Han Li’s lightning just made a demonic heir panic. Wen Tianren’s response? A set of eight ancient mirrors that makes Han Li freeze.

lore_anchors.definition: A specialized Yang-aligned lightning that is the bane of demonic techniques; produced by ten-thousand-year Gold Lightning Bamboo.
An ancient treasure formed from eight golden mirrors; a chained beam that grows stronger with each rebound.
A rare mutant form of Thunder Bamboo; its lightning can pierce demonic defenses.
A high-level manifestation of demonic power, often used as a trump card by practitioners of demonic techniques.
